headline: SpaceX Catches Starship with Launch Tower Arms After 22-Hour Orbital Test
summary: SpaceX's Starship returned from a 22-hour orbital voyage and was caught in mid-air by mechanical arms at its Texas launch pad, advancing its reusable rocket system. European private equity firm EQT highlighted moves to expand European launch capacity.
why: The development of fully reusable megarockets drastically lowers payload launch costs, transforming satellite commercial deployment and telecom infrastructure.

impacts.name: Commercial Space Industry
impacts.why: A successful mid-air recovery of the orbital Starship vessel validates fully reusable heavy-lift space transport economics.
